comparison.objective: Use a physical mouse to drag a screen file into the green folder.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain button pressure while making millimetre-scale planar pointer motion and keeping the mouse flat.
comparison.success_condition: Correct drop, button released, hand clear and mouse upright on mat for one second; wrong drops and mat departure invalidate.
comparison.reason: Fine force and motion control are shared only generically; the tested ability is high-gain interface manipulation, not tool-mediated fracture and debris recovery.
